decisions.reason: Lines 8-10 define the dated rollout scope: SG/MY/IN cashflows enter the RATAN blotter only after trade validation, CN follows its existing BAU, operators monitor and manually push exceptions when validation is unavailable on value date, and a September 2024 Stella/CDU auto-validation enhancement was still TBC. The source says manual exception handling continues until trade migration. I selected this behavior-relevant plan and preserved its dated/proposed status. I omitted the populated payment/trade examples and production-volume observations on lines 21-22, plus the separate group-blotter behavior on lines 16-17.
